title: Sunny Steps
prompt: Instrumental acoustic soul-pop with a light bossa-nova groove, 96 BPM in 4/4, sunny and playfully confident but relaxed: warm Rhodes electric piano, fingerpicked nylon guitar, rounded melodic bass, brushed drums and soft shakers, with a mellow marimba sharing a short memorable rising-and-falling hook with the piano. Use gently syncopated rhythms, warm major-sixth and ninth chords, natural human dynamics and a clear uncluttered mix with soft treble; no vocals, humming, whistles, piercing bells, heavy bass, claps, dramatic swells or sound effects. Over 64 bars introduce the hook immediately, alternate four related melodic ideas and occasional sparse guitar-and-bass passages every eight bars, return to the opening harmony and same groove at the end for continuous looping, with no silence, fade-out, final chord or big ending.
